description: Global hydro-environmental attribute database built on HydroSHEDS: enriched sub-basin polygons (BasinATLAS, 12 Pfafstetter levels), river reach lines (RiverATLAS), and lake/reservoir polygons (LakeATLAS). Each feature carries dozens of attributes spanning hydrology, physiography, climate, land cover and use, soils and geology, and human influence, alongside its geometry.
title: HydroATLAS Mirror
